newsitem.title: UK: Ford to cut costs with virtual assembly - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ford to cut costs with virtual assembly - paper.

text.p: Ford Motor Co is set to cut 120 million pounds a year from development costs for new vehicles with the introduction of a new computer modelling system to test production layouts, the Financial Times newspaper said on Monday.
The paper reported Ford as saying the C3P system was a breakthrough for the entire industry and would be used within two years to model all new plants and products in the company.

"It represents the most fundamental change in the computer-aided infrastructure ever undertaken at Ford," Neil Reissler, vice-president of Ford's Advanced Vehicle Technology group, was quoted as saying.
